events.x: The May Revolution (Spanish: Revolución de Mayo) was a week-long series of events that took place from 18 to 25 May 1810, in Buenos Aires, capital of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata. This Spanish colony included roughly the territories of present-day Argentina, Bolivia, Paraguay, Uruguay, and parts of Brazil. Outcome: The Primera Junta seized the government, ousting the Spanish viceroy Baltasar Hidalgo de Cisneros and launching a series of military expeditions that began the Argentine War of Independence..
